<translate>
<!--T:4-->
A '''Gomah Camp''' is a palisade camp with tents, a campfire and a [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah|Gomah]] soldier, on any of the three floors of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]]. Killing the soldier starts the [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah's Army|Gomah's Army]] raid.
</translate>

<translate>
== Starting the raid == <!--T:5-->
</translate>
{{Main|Gomah's Army}}
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
* When you come within 80 blocks of a camp, you get a chat warning.
* Each camp has one scout, the Gomah soldier, shown with a supervillain aura. Killing it starts [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah's Army|Gomah's Army]].
* A camp is spent once its scout dies or disappears.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:7-->
See [[Special:MyLanguage/Raids|Raids]] for how a raid plays out.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding one == <!--T:8-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:9-->
Gomah Camps generate on any of the three Demon Worlds, kept away from the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Village|demon villages]]. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate gomah_camp}} in the Demon Realm to find the nearest one.
</translate>
